issue_body:
- `input_stream` is explicitly documented as unsafe compared to its wrapped counterpart in `stream`.
- `remote_user` is only mentioned in passing as part of CGI that WSGI accepts for compatibility.
- `is_multithread`, `is_multiprocess`, and `is_run_once` are about how the server is running workers. But I can't think of how that matters to the application, code must avoid globals and use external storage regardless of the worker type.
- All of these can be accessed directly from `request.environ` if needed, they even still have their correct types.
- I can't find any uses of `environ_property` (or `header_property`) in external code.
- None of the many other WSGI and CGI keys are exposed.
- ASGI has no concept of any of these.
